about: CI cost manifest (ci-spend law, 2026-10-11). One entry per workflow, one leg per runner OS. scripts/check_workflow_runner_cost.py fails a workflow or OS leg without an entry, an entry without a benefit, triggers/crons/jobs that differ from the workflow file, $ that do not add up, a repo total over repo_share_usd, and (locally, with sibling repos beside it) a sum over the weekly ceiling.
prices_source: GitHub billing API pricePerUnit (Actions Linux / Windows / macOS 3-core), read 2026-10-11

ci.yml.benefit: Matrx Local checks (Python, frontend, Rust; Windows Rust).
ci.yml.owner_reason: Matrx Local proof before a release.
ci.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 225 push runs/week x 13.2 Linux + 2 Windows min (HEAD triggers; going manual-only)

egress-helper.yml.benefit: Builds/packages the Home Connection helper on every OS.
egress-helper.yml.owner_reason: The helper ships as a sidecar and standalone.

off-host-release.yml.benefit: Serialized hosted version bump that starts a release.
off-host-release.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 188/week (pre-retirement); forward 2/week x 4.8 min

release.yml.benefit: Builds and publishes the Matrx Local desktop installers (mac/win/linux).
release.yml.owner_reason: Matrx Local release path (manual only; being retired).
release.yml.basis: observed 2026-10-02..09 (runs list + sampled jobs' billed minutes): 170/week pre-retirement; forward 2/week (mac 81, win 40, linux 30 min)
